class Token93A { function __destruct() { echo 'TOKEN|'; } }
class Origin93A {
    function capture() {
        return function (&$token) {
            static $counter = 0;
            $counter = $counter + 1;
            echo 'BODY|', $counter, '|';
            try { yield $counter; }
            finally { echo 'FIN|', $counter, '|'; }
        };
    }
    function __destruct() { echo 'OLD|'; }
}
class Active93A { function __destruct() { echo 'MAKER|'; } }
function NewToken93A() { global $weakToken; $token = new Token93A(); $weakToken = WeakReference::create($token); return $token; }
function Warn93A($severity, $message) {
    global $source, $warningCount;
    echo 'WARN|'; $warningCount = $warningCount + 1;
    $slot = null; $probe = $source($slot);
    echo 'PROBE|', $probe->current(), '|';
    unset($probe);
    return true;
}
$old = new Origin93A(); $weakOld = WeakReference::create($old);
$source = $old->capture(); $weakSource = WeakReference::create($source); unset($old);
$slot = null; $seed = $source($slot); echo 'SEED|', $seed->current(), '|';
unset($seed);
$warningCount = 0; set_error_handler('Warn93A');
$maker = new Active93A(); $weakMaker = WeakReference::create($maker);
echo 'CALL|'; $g = $source->call($maker, NewToken93A());
restore_error_handler();
unset($source, $maker);
echo 'FRESH|', $warningCount === 1, '|', $weakSource->get() === null, '|', $weakOld->get() === null, '|', $weakMaker->get() instanceof Active93A, '|', $weakToken->get() instanceof Token93A, '|';
echo 'VALUE|', $g->current(), '|'; $g->next();
echo 'DONE|', $g->getReturn() === null, '|', $weakMaker->get() instanceof Active93A, '|', $weakToken->get() === null, '|';
